name: d1-iron-outpost
note: A player's delegated chore: add an untouched iron patch (~300 tiles from base) and belt its ore to a train stop 35 tiles away. Constraints: belts (not bots), this patch, end at the stop. Power is at the stop. Materials are in the base's chests (20 electric drills, 637 belts, 100 small poles).

objectives.name: iron-outpost
objectives.goal: @{agent} add the iron patch I'm standing on [gps={px},{py}] to our system: put electric mining drills on it and bring the ore by belt to the train stop at [gps={sx},{sy}]. End the belt right next to the track by the stop; if you can, load the parked cargo wagon at [gps={wx},{wy}] with inserters. There's power at the stop. Use belts, not bots.

score.name: drills_on_patch
score.lua: local p=storage.bench_outpost.patch local a={{p[1]-2,p[2]-2},{p[3]+2,p[4]+2}} return s.count_entities_filtered{name="electric-mining-drill", area=a}

score.name: ore_at_stop
score.lua:
local o=storage.bench_outpost local n=0
for _,b in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type={"transport-belt","underground-belt","splitter"}, position=o.stop, radius=16}) do
  for i=1,b.get_max_transport_line_index() do n=n+b.get_transport_line(i).get_item_count("iron-ore") end end
local w=s.find_entities_filtered{name="cargo-wagon", position=o.stop, radius=20}[1]
if w then n=n+w.get_item_count("iron-ore") end
return n
score.note: iron ore on belts within 16 tiles of the stop plus in the wagon

score.name: drills_working
score.lua: local p=storage.bench_outpost.patch local a={{p[1]-2,p[2]-2},{p[3]+2,p[4]+2}} local k=0 for _,d in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{name="electric-mining-drill", area=a}) do if d.status==defines.entity_status.working then k=k+1 end end return k

score.name: wagon_ore
score.lua: local w=s.find_entities_filtered{name="cargo-wagon", position=storage.bench_outpost.stop, radius=20}[1] return w and w.get_item_count("iron-ore") or 0
